llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous signs of a scam: use of generic psychological selling points to create false urgency and trust; complete absence of verifiable business details or contact info; only a form present for contact; privacy policy and payment details are vague or missing; the domain is newly registered with all WHOIS info redacted and hosted behind Cloudflare; no real product details or navigation, indicating the site is a template or copy; broad, unfocused product categories; SSL certificate issues suggesting poor security. These are all classic characteristics of fake online shopping scams.
